scope: F3 local edit/selection ownership within the current style/performance delivery. F2 native compositor smooth-scroll capture remains a separate known limitation.
logic: The input proxy registers editing intent synchronously before queueing. Accepted editing receipts record their actual inputSeq; projection remains deferred until no editing action is pending and the displayed frame covers that sequence. Pure pointer movement leaves editing projection available.

Native client widgets keep local uncontrolled values. A single layout projection applies canonical text/value/checked/select options/focus/selection after ownership permits. Source geometry and Canvas pairs continue to update normally.

Text input maintains a persistent known value/selection tuple. Projection records the target tuple before DOM changes. Asynchronous select events with the same tuple are deduplicated. Actual selection-key revisions preserve repeated SelectAll intent even when the range is unchanged.

Active local composition retains its client state through commit/cancel acknowledgment and presented input sequence. Program focus records known focus before focusing. Old owner control callbacks are dropped when their expected instance is no longer current.
ACK/failure updates local projection state so an already displayed confirming frame can apply immediately. This React update is limited to editing actions; pointermove does not add these rerenders.
